assertion.name: Mixed Supporting-cell Lineage-marker Expression
assertion.description: SOX9-only Sertoli cells, FOXL2-only precursor granulosa cells and cells expressing both markers occurred in distinct areas of the same infant gonad. Coexpression indicates mixed lineage-marker expression; SRY immunostaining alone cannot assign a karyotype to every cell type.
assertion.notes: Needs term / NTR: OLS NCIT search for SOX9 FOXL2 coexpression found no matching immunophenotypic finding.

selected_evidence.snippet: Unexpectedly, our case showed co-expression of SOX9 and FOXL2 in abnormally shaped seminiferous tubules and gonadoblastomas.

assertion.name: Arrested Spermatogenesis
assertion.description: Arrested spermatogenesis was among the histologic patterns in a multicenter male cohort; focal spermatogenesis was also present in some samples. The cohort included genital and nongenital routes of ascertainment.
assertion.notes: Needs term / NTR: OLS NCIT search for spermatogenic arrest found no exact histopathology term. The source percentage is retained only in the quote because its abstract does not fully specify each histologic denominator.

selected_evidence.snippet: Twenty-five percent had focal spermatogenesis, and another 25.0% had arrested spermatogenesis.

assertion.name: Mixed Seminiferous and Undifferentiated Gonadal Architecture
assertion.description: A resected gonad from one infant contained normal-appearing and abnormally shaped seminiferous tubules, undifferentiated gonadal tissue and gonadoblastoma nests. This demonstrates intragonadal heterogeneity, not a universal histologic pattern.
assertion.notes: Needs term / NTR: OLS NCIT search for seminiferous tubule dysplasia found no exact histopathology term; a generic dysplasia binding would discard the mixed architectural finding.

selected_evidence.snippet: Histology of the gonad showed a streak testis consisting predominantly of differentiated normal-appearing seminiferous tubules with an area of undifferentiated gonadal tissue (UGT) and abnormally shaped seminiferous tubules at the periphery of the gonad

assertion.name: Prognostic Immunohistochemical Markers (CD56, GATA-4, SMAD3)
assertion.description: A systematic review of prognostic markers in adult granulosa cell tumor found immunohistochemical expression of CD56, GATA-4 and SMAD3 to be associated with reduced prognosis, while estrogen receptor, anti-Mullerian hormone and inhibin staining carried no prognostic information despite AMH and inhibin being the established circulating disease markers. Mitotic rate, Ki-67, p53, beta-catenin and HER2 gave inconsistent results across studies. The SMAD3 signal is of mechanistic interest because SMAD2/3 activation in the presence of FOXL2 is the shared feature of the genetically unrelated Foxo1/3/Pten mouse tumor model.

selected_evidence.snippet: FOXL2 mutation and FOXL2 mRNA were inverse and immunohistochemical (IHC) expression of CD56, GATA-4 and SMAD3 was associated with reduced prognosis. IHC analysis of estrogen receptor, Anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH) and inhibin was not associated with prognosis for GCT.

assertion.name: C1q accumulation in glomerular capillary loops and mesangium
assertion.description: Strong C1q deposition in capillary loops and mesangium on renal biopsy, reported alongside the nephrotic syndrome. This is what gives the renal lesion its alternative name in the literature, where SCARB2 disease is sometimes reported as progressive myoclonus epilepsy with C1q nephropathy. It sits beside rather than instead of the collapsing focal segmental glomerulosclerosis curated under phenotypes, and the entry does not assert that either is the invariable renal histology. The two are not confined to separate families: one patient (II.13 of the Turkish p.N45MfsX88 family) has C1q, C3 and IgM deposition and FSGS in the same biopsy. That biopsy is reported as FSGS without the collapsing qualifier, so what co-occurs there is C1q deposition with FSGS, not specifically with the collapsing variant.

finding_term.preferred_term: C1q deposition in glomerular capillary loops and mesangium

selected_evidence.snippet: He underwent a renal biopsy, and it showed FSGS. Immunofluorescence microscopy showed deposition of one positive C1q, C3, and IgM in capillary loops.

assertion.name: C1q accumulation in glomerular capillary loops and mesangium
assertion.description: Strong C1q deposition in capillary loops and mesangium on renal biopsy, reported alongside the nephrotic syndrome. This is what gives the renal lesion its alternative name in the literature, where SCARB2 disease is sometimes reported as progressive myoclonus epilepsy with C1q nephropathy. It sits beside rather than instead of the collapsing focal segmental glomerulosclerosis curated under phenotypes, and the entry does not assert that either is the invariable renal histology. The two are not confined to separate families: one patient (II.13 of the Turkish p.N45MfsX88 family) has C1q, C3 and IgM deposition and FSGS in the same biopsy. That biopsy is reported as FSGS without the collapsing qualifier, so what co-occurs there is C1q deposition with FSGS, not specifically with the collapsing variant.

finding_term.preferred_term: C1q deposition in glomerular capillary loops and mesangium

selected_evidence.snippet: The main clinical features of two siblings from a consanguineous marriage were progressive myoclonic epilepsy without intellectual impairment and a nephrotic syndrome with a strong accumulation of C1q in capillary loops and mesangium of kidney.
